method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: US Stocks Rally to End a Turbulent Month; Amazon Jumps 15%
Equities.reason: Large-cap AI/mega-cap-led rally (Amazon) driving market upside — reinforces risk-on/AI leadership narrative and market concentration into a few names.

Equities.title: Biggest Wall Street Rotation Since 2020 Shows AI Crowding Risks
Equities.reason: Highlights crowded positioning into AI names and rotation dynamics — raises medium-term downside risk for concentrated tech exposure and amplifies volatility concerns.

Equities.title: Citadel’s swoop on Situational Awareness helped stem a $3tn AI rout
Equities.summary: Investors say the hedge fund deal reassured jittery traders in tech stocks
Equities.reason: Intervention-like rescue calms market stress tied to an AI-focused hedge fund collapse — positive for short-term risk sentiment and liquidity in tech names.

Equities.title: Situational Awareness got the future right but misread the past
Equities.summary: Leopold Aschenbrenner thought AI-related stocks would go one way; they went the other. The mistake was funding the trades with debt
Equities.reason: Leverage-driven blowup in an AI hedge fund underscores systemic/liquidity risks from crowded thematic bets — negative for risk appetite and highlights tail risk in AI trade.

Equities.title: Alphabet, Amazon and Microsoft added nearly $1.5 trillion in combined value this week
Equities.summary: Amazon, Microsoft and Google added hundreds of billions of dollars to their market caps, while Apple and Meta saw their market valuations fall.
Equities.reason: Concentration of market gains in a few mega-cap AI beneficiaries — positive for headline indices and risk-on sentiment but increases single-stock dependence of market performance.

Equities.title: Dwindling cash and soaring memory costs: Tech's AI buildout has ballooning price tag
Equities.summary: Amazon, Alphabet and Tesla all reported negative cash flow in the latest quarter, while Meta's cash generation plummeted by 91%.
Equities.reason: Rising capex and memory costs strain tech cash flow — a headwind to profitability for AI infrastructure plays and a potential check on exuberant tech multiples.

Equities.title: Microsoft shares are surging. Here’s how to still make money, says Mike Khouw
Equities.summary: Following Microsoft's (MSFT) Q4 earnings and record-setting appreciation, the immediate binary event risk is officially behind us.
Equities.reason: Single-stock momentum in a mega-cap (Microsoft) reinforces AI leadership narrative; included at lower relevance (idiosyncratic but market-significant given MSFT size).

Equities.title: The S&P 500 is stuck at a key battleground level. This obscure index could determine the market’s next move
Equities.summary: Options traders and market makers in Chicago were quick to buy dips below 7,500 in the benchmark index Friday, but almost as quick to sell rallies above that level.
Equities.reason: Technical battleground and options flow indicate a fragile equilibrium — suggests limited upside without broader participation, raising short-term downside/volatility risk.

Equities.title: Traders Gird for More S&P 500 Volatility as Marco Risks Rise
Equities.reason: Market participants preparing for higher volatility amid macro/regime risks — negative for calm risk-on positioning and supportive of higher hedging demand.

Equities.title: Anthropic says its Claude models 'gained unauthorized access' to other organizations' systems
Equities.summary: Anthropic said it discovered three instances where its Claude AI models accessed the internet during an evaluation and accessed outside systems.
Equities.reason: AI security incidents raise trust and regulatory concerns for AI-exposed stocks — modestly negative for investor appetite in the AI thematic.

Equities.title: Trump's AI executive order nears key deadline as regulation debate intensifies
Equities.summary: OpenAI's Sam Altman and Nvidia's Jensen Huang were among tech leaders in Washington, D.C., ahead of a deadline the White House set in its AI executive order.
Equities.reason: Imminent regulatory actions increase policy risk for AI/tech firms — a negative for valuation multiples and the unencumbered growth narrative.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
Rates.reason: FOMC statement anchors policy path for rates; current Fed tone and forward guidance support a higher-for-longer narrative that pressures bond prices (yields up). High relevance as the primary policy document for US rates.

Rates.title: Bond sell-off sent warning on Fed’s credibility, says top central bank official
Rates.summary: Alberto Musalem says he supported dissenters’ calls for a quarter-point interest rate rise
Rates.reason: Article ties a broad bond-market sell-off to calls for additional Fed tightening and credibility concerns — reinforces a regime of rising yields and market volatility; high relevance to rates pricing.

Rates.title: Fed dissenters warn inflation could become entrenched without monetary policy tightening now
Rates.reason: Headline signals internal Fed hawkish pressure that supports tighter policy expectations and upward pressure on yields; relevant to near‑term rates outlook.

Rates.title: Fed officials who voted to hike rates say action is needed now against inflation
Rates.reason: Direct quotes from Fed voters advocating immediate action raise the odds of further tightening — negative for bond prices, meaningful relevance to markets pricing Fed path.

Rates.title: Fed's Barkin: It's a close call whether interest rates are high enough
Rates.summary: Richmond Federal Reserve (Fed) President Tom Barkin said on Friday that it remains uncertain whether the current level of interest rates is sufficiently restrictive to bring inflation back to the Fed's 2% target, according to an interview with The Wall Street
Rates.reason: Senior Fed official flags uncertainty on whether policy is restrictive enough — leans toward potential further hikes and supports higher-for-longer pricing, moderate relevance.

Rates.title: BlackRock’s ‘Widow Maker’ Treasury ETF Slides to 2004 Low
Rates.reason: Major Treasury ETF hitting multi-decade lows signals sustained outflows and structural selling in the Treasury market — negative for bond prices and indicative of stress in risk-free yields.

Rates.title: US Treasury Weighs Repo Entry That Could Reshape Funding Markets
Rates.reason: A Treasury repo facility would inject significant short-term liquidity into funding markets and could ease upward pressure on short-term yields — supportive for bond prices, material for funding-sensitive rates.

Rates.title: Investors may want to focus on front end of yield curve — as Street anticipates next Fed meetings
Rates.reason: Street advice to concentrate on the front end reflects expectations of near-term Fed action and front-end rate volatility — negative for short-term bond prices and relevant to curve positioning.

Rates.title: Analysis: Markets heard a dovish Kevin Warsh. The Fed chairman's own words suggest a rate hike
Rates.summary: Investors saw Warsh’s press conference as dovish, but a closer reading of the Fed chair's prepared remarks suggests he may be close to raising interest rates.
Rates.reason: Analysis highlights market misread of Fed messaging and the possibility of forthcoming hikes — reinforces hawkish interpretation and upward pressure on yields.

Rates.title: Bank Rate maintained at 3.75% - July 2026 Monetary Policy Summary and Minutes
Rates.summary: The Bank of England’s Monetary Policy Committee is responsible for making decisions about Bank Rate.
Rates.reason: BoE held Bank Rate at a relatively elevated level; neutral-to-slightly hawkish for gilt yields (no easing), moderate relevance to UK rates.

Rates.title: Statement on Monetary Policy
Rates.reason: BoJ policy statement can influence JGBs and global rates via yield differentials; current messaging appears calibrated but leaves room for market sensitivity — modest negative tilt given global tightening norms.

Rates.title: Quarterly Schedule of Outright Purchases of Japanese Government Bonds (Competitive Auction Method) (July-September 2026) (Schedule Updates)
Rates.reason: BOJ outright purchase schedule represents central-bank demand for JGBs which supports bond prices (pushes yields lower); relevant to JGB market technicals and global rates via carry/flows.

Rates.title: ECB to start implementing enhanced repo facility for central banks
Rates.reason: An enhanced repo facility for central banks is an operational liquidity tool that can ease strains and modestly reduce short-term yield pressures in Europe; limited but positive effect for bond markets.

Rates.title: ECB wage tracker at 2.7% in Q1 2027, indicating stable negotiated wage pressures
Rates.reason: Stable wage growth reduces the risk of persistent domestic inflation in the euro area — supportive for euro-area bonds (yields lower) and moderates hawkish ECB expectations.

Rates.title: India: RBI hold expectations shape policy outlook – ING
Rates.summary: ING economists Deepali Bhargava and Lynn Song expect the Reserve Bank of India to keep the repo rate at 5.25% this week. They note that while June headline inflation rose on higher fuel prices, core inflation remains below target.
Rates.reason: RBI expected to hold rates — limited global impact but marginally supportive for Indian sovereign bonds relative to hiking risk.

Rates.title: China: Policy support balances weak PMIs – UOB
Rates.summary: UOB economist Ho Woei Chen highlights that China’s July CFLP PMIs slipped into contraction, with both manufacturing and non-manufacturing gauges signaling broad-based weakness in activity. The report notes particularly soft industrial output and services, whil
Rates.reason: Chinese policy support in response to weakening PMIs suggests potential easing measures that would be supportive for Chinese sovereign and credit spreads (lower yields), modest relevance.

FX.title: US Treasury undertakes historic intervention in yen market
FX.summary: New York Fed sells euros to buy yen following recent speculation that Tokyo intervened to support Japan’s currency
FX.reason: Explicit, high‑impact central‑bank/official action in the yen market (New York Fed/US Treasury involvement) is a major FX shock that weakens the broad USD narrative and directly supports JPY — large directional impact and high relevance.

FX.title: US Treasury informed banks that it may intervene in Japan's yen, source says
FX.reason: Official signalling that the US Treasury may intervene increases the probability of coordinated action and materially changes USD flow expectations — clear USD‑centric FX news with direct market transmission.

FX.title: Rare joint currency intervention sends strong message to markets
FX.reason: Reports of coordinated (Japan + Korea) intervention are a regime‑level event for FX, tightening JPY and EMFX behaviour and putting downside pressure on the DXY — strong, broad market relevance.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index struggles near 100 after suspected Japanese intervention
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY) struggles to hold its early recovery on Friday as the fallout from suspected Japanese intervention and the possibility of direct action by the United States (US) keep the Greenback under pressure.
FX.reason: Direct DXY move tied to suspected Japanese intervention — clear USD weakness narrative with tangible index‑level impact; medium‑high relevance for FX positioning.

FX.title: Japanese Yen surges amid hawkish BoJ
FX.summary: USD/JPY trades sharply lower near the 159.50 area on Friday as the Japanese Yen (JPY) strengthens following intervention by Japanese authorities and a relatively hawkish Bank of Japan (BoJ) policy announcement.
FX.reason: Combination of suspected intervention and a hawkish BoJ shifts yen dynamics materially lower for USD/JPY — direct FX pair impact and significant for USD‑centric flows.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Intervention slows but does not reverse trend – ING
FX.summary: ING’s Chris Turner describes USD/JPY’s rollercoaster, with a 3% drop on reported Japanese intervention followed by a near 2% rebound. He notes that coordinated Fed-Treasury involvement was key in January but now sees the story as having moved on.
FX.reason: Analyst view that intervention is a near‑term shock but not a trend reversal — relevant as a tempering/counterpoint to intervention headlines, lower relevance than direct intervention reports.

FX.title: Swiss Franc trims losses against US Dollar amid Japanese intervention concerns
FX.summary: USD/CHF trims part of its earlier gains on Friday as the US Dollar (USD) struggles to regain momentum following Thursday’s sharp sell-off, which was driven by suspected intervention by Japanese authorities to curb excessive weakness in the Japanese Yen (JPY).
FX.reason: Shows spillovers from yen intervention into other USD crosses (CHF) — supports the broader USD‑weakness / intervention narrative but is a secondary, cross‑asset effect.

FX.title: Euro recovers as Eurozone inflation stays firm
FX.summary: EUR/USD trades near the 1.1530 area during Friday's American session, consolidating after a strong rally off intraday lows. The Euro found support from resilient Eurozone inflation data, although gains remain capped as hawkish Federal Reserve (Fed) rhetoric bo
FX.reason: EUR moves tied to Eurozone inflation data and Fed rhetoric — relevant to USD direction but smaller in magnitude versus intervention headlines; included as part of broader USD‑sensitivity picture.

FX.title: British Pound holds firm as USD rebounds from intervention rout
FX.summary: The Pound Sterling retreats some 0.02% on Friday as the Greenback stages a recovery following Thursday’s intervention day, which weakened the US Dollar Index (DXY) to a 30-day low. At the time of writing, the GBP/USD trades at 1.3458, virtually unchanged.
FX.reason: Notes a short‑term USD rebound following intervention volatility — a counter‑signal to the USD‑weakness theme and useful for gauging intraday USD recovery risk; lower relevance than intervention reports.

Commodities.title: Gold slides as US yields surge, keeping $4,100 out of reach
Commodities.summary: Gold price tumbles nearly 1.50% on Friday as the US Dollar recovers some ground after Japanese authorities intervened in the foreign exchange markets a day ago, driving the Greenback to a 30-day low before recovering, according to the US Dollar Index (DXY). Th
Commodities.reason: Higher U.S. yields and a firmer USD are direct headwinds for non-yielding gold; article is focused on metal price drivers (rates, FX), so moderately high relevance.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD consolidates above $55 as downside momentum eases
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) trades on the back foot on Friday as rising US Treasury yields outweigh support from a weaker US Dollar (USD). At the time of writing, XAG/USD trades around $57.50, down 2% on the day and on track to close July in negative territory.
Commodities.reason: Rising U.S. yields weigh on silver similarly to gold; this is a price-forecast/technical piece so relevance capped per framework.

Commodities.title: Energia Costa Azul, Mexico's second LNG terminal, shipped first cargo
Commodities.summary: Energia Costa Azul, the second liquefied natural gas (LNG) export facility in Mexico, shipped its initial cargo from Phase 1 of the terminal on July 8, according to the project developer. The completion of the project adds 0.4 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d
Commodities.reason: New LNG export capacity increases supply/flows for natural gas (negative price impulse); the addition is modest (0.4 Bcf/d), so relevance and directional magnitude are limited.

Commodities.title: China's crude oil imports fell in the second quarter
Commodities.summary: China, the world's largest importer of crude oil, imported less crude oil in the second quarter of 2026 (2Q26) following higher crude oil prices that resulted from disrupted flows through the Strait of Hormuz. China's lower imports reduced global demand, softe
Commodities.reason: A decline in Chinese crude imports is a material demand-side signal for global oil balances; this reduces price pressure and offsets some supply-driven upside from geopolitics.

Commodities.title: WTI Oil recovers above $83 ahead of OPEC meeting
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) US Oil trades higher on Friday, rising 0.76% to around $83.30 after staging a sharp rebound from an intraday low below $80.00.
Commodities.reason: Price rebound into the mid-$80s and near-term OPEC meeting implies bullish supply/policy risk for WTI; market-moving for oil with clear transmission to the commodity.

Commodities.title: Commercial crude oil inventories increased by 2.0 million barrels
Commodities.summary: For the week ending July 17, 2026, commercial crude oil inventories (excluding the Strategic Petroleum Reserve) increased 2.0 million barrels to 411.7 million barrels, 6% below the previous five-year (2021–2025) average. Gasoline inventories increased 0.8 mill
Commodities.reason: Weekly crude inventory build is a direct short-term bearish signal for oil prices; the build is modest and inventories remain below multi-year averages, so impact is limited.

Commodities.title: US and Israel plan to attack Iran's energy infrastructure – CBS News
Commodities.summary: CBS News reported that the United States and Israel may engage in a large campaign against Iran, targeting Iran's energy infrastructure, said multiple sources.
Commodities.reason: A potential coordinated attack on Iran's energy infrastructure is a major supply-risk event for oil (large directional impact and high relevance). Coverage is not fully confirmed, so relevance is high but not at the absolute max.

Commodities.title: Hedge Funds Add Bullish Bets on Oil at Fastest Pace Since March
Commodities.reason: Shift in speculative positioning toward bullish oil amplifies price momentum and risk-on positioning in crude; useful flow signal with medium-high relevance.

Commodities.title: Oil price rises after Iran says it stops ships in Hormuz
Commodities.reason: Iran stopping ships in the Strait of Hormuz is a direct and immediate supply chokepoint risk; Reuters coverage indicates real-time market reaction, producing a strong positive oil impulse.

Commodities.title: Exxon and Chevron profits surge on rising oil prices due to Iran war
Commodities.summary: ExxonMobil and Chevron on Friday reported second-quarter profits that surged on rising oil prices due to the Iran war.
Commodities.reason: Earnings driven by higher oil prices reinforce the commodity-price narrative; company results are secondary evidence of rising oil but useful for sentiment/flow context.

Crypto.title: Circle secures New York trust charter as crypto regulatory push accelerates
Crypto.reason: A New York trust charter for Circle is a meaningful regulatory/institutional milestone that improves on‑ramp credibility and custody/regulatory clarity — supportive for institutional adoption and liquidity in crypto markets.

Crypto.title: How bitcoin cold wallets lost $70 million in an attack that never touched the devices
Crypto.reason: A large, novel exploit that bypasses cold-wallet security undermines confidence in self‑custody, raises systemic custody risk and could materially weigh on retail/institutional demand and flows.

Crypto.title: Coldcard's $38 million (so far) exploit shakes faith in self-custody, may push investors to ETFs
Crypto.reason: High‑profile hardware wallet exploit erodes trust in self‑custody and may accelerate flows into custodial products and ETFs — a negative for native crypto custody demand but supportive for custodial product growth.

Crypto.title: Dubai-based crypto exchange tied to $4 billion Iran sanctioned-evasion network
Crypto.reason: Links between a major exchange and a large sanctions‑evasion network raise regulatory and enforcement risks globally, hurting market trust and increasing the prospect of crackdowns or tighter rules.

Crypto.title: Global banks test tokenized money for cross-border payments in $1 million BIS pilot
Crypto.reason: A BIS‑linked pilot with global banks testing tokenized money is a constructive institutional adoption signal for tokenization and payment rails that can expand real-world use cases for crypto tech.

Crypto.title: ​Traders brace for an August crypto pull-back as protection against $60,000 bitcoin dip becomes top trade
Crypto.reason: Options positioning (buying downside protection) signals hedging and elevated near‑term tail risk, reflecting cautious market sentiment that could pressure prices in the short term.

Crypto.title: Coinbase sinks 5% after missing second-quarter revenue estimates
Crypto.reason: Weaker exchange operator results can dampen sentiment and trading volumes, marginally negative for crypto market flows and risk appetite.

Crypto.title: XRP Ledger upgrade brings back features once pulled over critical bugs
Crypto.reason: Restoring previously removed features after bug fixes improves protocol stability and functionality for the XRP ecosystem — a modestly positive development for adoption and operational confidence.
